system.description: You gather flames in your palm and steer them gently. Make a Spellcast Roll (15) within Melee range. On a success, mark a Stress to heal 2 Hit Points, clear 2 Stress or remove a Condition. On a failure, mark a Stress to heal a Hit Point or clear a Stress on the target. You can only affect a target in this way once per Rest.
system.usageNote: Once per target per Rest. Track affected targets in Notes.
